pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of scaling into consecutive losing positions within a 60-second window; pyramiding is limited to profitable nodes with a minimum 2R cushion.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero-order entry execution permitted if ATR(14) exceeds 3.5x its 50-period moving average unless confirmed by a multi-timeframe volume delta divergence.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate automated partial scale-outs at +$15.00 and lock trailing hard stops at breakeven +$2.00 to prevent floating gains from evaporating.
